To: (email hidden)

Subject: Shop···· – quick question before my cancel window closes

Hi Sarah,

I've only had automated replies so far, so I'm hoping a real person can help 🙂 You told me next day reply from real support is normal

Can you confirm my 40T order (Shop···· / ····) is still on track to ship on 7 Dec? Y or N is fine.

My 14-day window ends on 5 Nov, and I'd like to make my decision before then.

Thanks,
Philip S. from [Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail/home) for Android.
Note to the team: I'll pull the order up before I answer.

Hi Philip,

Yes. Shop···· is paid, and your Magic Miner 40T from Batch 8 still carries 7 December 2026 as its ship date. Nothing on your order has moved since we last wrote.

On your earlier question about the Thor P2, sorry you had to ask twice for it. The Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s) is $379 and is in stock, shipping within 2 business days. Two of them would be $758 against the $799 you paid, so roughly even money, but you would be trading 40 TH/s for 20 TH/s. Per terahash the 40T is the better unit by a wide margin, which is why I would keep it unless getting hardware running now matters more to you than hashrate.

If you do want the change made, just reply and say so, and a colleague will set it up on the same order number. The team is offline right now and picks it up today from 10am Eastern, with the answer coming back to you here.

You can also follow the incoming batches on their way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Philip,

You're right, and that's fair. Here is the straight answer, no hand-off.

Yes. Shop···· is paid, and your Magic Miner 40T from Batch 8 still carries 7 December 2026 as its ship date. Nothing on the order has changed since 22 October, and your (address hidden) address is the one on it.

On the Thor P2 question you asked before and never got answered, sorry about that. The Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s) is $379 and is in stock now, shipping within 2 business days. Two of them come to $758 against the $799 on your order, so near enough even money, but you would be going from 40 TH/s down to 20 TH/s. Per terahash the 40T is the better buy, which is why I'd keep it unless having hardware running this month matters more to you than hashrate.

If you decide you want the Thor P2s instead, reply here with a yes and we'll change it on the same order number.

You can follow the incoming batches on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
